specialties.name: Bowmaster
specialties.intent: You plant your feet and the fight comes to you at your distance; the price of that reach is that you cannot keep the one hex of daylight everyone else lives on.
specialties.source: Hell-TCG Ranger/Bowmaster (item-slot dump rebuilt as Reach and a stand-still trigger) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: health -2; movement -1. | 2026-08-17: carried a condition the engine has no way to check (did-not-move / made-no-attack / moved-N-hexes). Condition removed and the effect reduced to match.

specialties.name: Winged Assassin
specialties.intent: You do not cross the ground, you cross the air above it. Whatever you touch bleeds, and anything that reaches you kills you.
specialties.source: Hell-TCG Ranger/Winged Assassin (onDamage Bleed kept; flight rebuilt as Movement and terrain-ignoring leaps) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: health -3; armor -1; dodge +10. Parked abilities: onKill: move up to 2 hexes immediately, ignoring difficult terrain. | 2026-08-17: Flight is a granted MOVEMENT ACTION (1 Movement per hex, passes over units and obstructions, takes nothing from the ground on the way, one click). Airwalk is a standing property covering only the hex you END your Turn on. Neither existed in the content. | 2026-08-20: flight is a granted movement POWER, never a property. Grants power.flight. The old "grants: [flight]" pointed at an id that never existed.

specialties.name: Wayfinder
specialties.intent: The Ranger who is fine once they close. Broken ground is free to you, and you are carrying enough to fight in it.

triggers.effect: Terrain that costs extra Movement to enter costs you nothing extra.

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Ranger/Wayfinder (pathfinding rebuilt as terrain immunity; melee lean kept) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: precision -1; strength +1; health +2. | 2026-08-17: +2 Strength / +3 Health / +2 Item Slots, no Precision loss. Strength is OFF-PRIMARY for a Ranger, so it has to be granted in quantity to be worth anything — that is what makes this the hybrid melee branch. The ally clause on the terrain trigger was too complicated and is cut.

specialties.name: Sentinel
specialties.intent: Really slow, and shooting from further away than anyone else on the field. You pick your hex once and the battle comes to you.
specialties.source: Hell-TCG Warden/Sentinel (onTakingDamage Poison kept; watchfulness rebuilt on Vision, which had no Hell-TCG equivalent) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: movement -1. Parked abilities: onActivationEnd: if you did not move this Turn, gain +1 Armor and +5 Accuracy until the end of your next Turn. | 2026-08-17: rebuilt. The old version wanted you stationary and armoured, which is a Warrior, not a Ranger. -2 Movement / +4 Health / +2 Reach / +1 Precision keeps the identity in the Ranger's own stats. Deliberately four stats with a negative — the negative IS the identity here. onTakingDamage trigger removed.

specialties.name: Trapper
specialties.intent: You do not fight the enemy, you fight the ground they are standing on, and they cannot see a single thing you have done to it.

triggers.effect: place one unseen trap on any hex within 3 hexes of your starting hex: the first enemy to enter it gains 2 Slow

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Warden/Trapper (whole-army Poison on entry rebuilt as placed, unseen, per-hex traps) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: health -1; vision +1. Parked abilities: onHit: an enemy standing in difficult terrain when you hit it gains 1 Weak. | 2026-08-20: "clean up that movement stuff." A one-Turn Movement loss is now the Slow status — apply N Slow. Fourteen entries said this two different ways and every one of them needed the engine to remember whose next Turn it was. Amount unchanged.

specialties.name: Protector
specialties.intent: You grow the battlefield a wall and stand behind it; nothing you do is fast, and everyone you are near is harder to kill than they were.

triggers.effect: AURA radius 1 — briars close in around you: every hex inside costs an enemy 1 extra Movement to enter.

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Warden/Protector (KEEPS the name in the Warden/Beast Protector collision; party-wide Resist rebuilt as a radius, powers drawn from Druid's nature line) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: precision -1; movement -1. Parked abilities: onAllyDamaged: if the ally is within 2 hexes of you or standing in difficult terrain, reduce that damage by 1. | 2026-08-17 off-primary pass: spirit +1 was off-primary for a Ranger; Resist does the warding job and is top of the ladder. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: replaced a placeholder aura with a distinct effect.

specialties.name: Magical Friend
specialties.intent: Something small and bright walks the field on your behalf: it heals what you cannot reach and you see through its eyes.

triggers.effect: summon your companion on any hex within 2 hexes of you. It is a summoned ally with its own stat block and its own AI, it has your Vision, and it does not attack

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Beast/Magical Friend (HoBaT has no pet system — gated on needsCapability rather than faked, and every power is written to measure from the companion's hex) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: strength -1; precision -1; health +2. | 2026-08-17 off-primary pass: two off-primaries at +1 was nothing; Magic doubled makes the branch real. | 2026-08-20: summoning is a feature we want — "we can summon something, it has an AI assigned to it, whether it is an enemy or a hero, and it has a stat block." The companion is the first thing that needs it, so it is written in those words now instead of as a bespoke pet. See engine/COMBAT-SEQUENCE.md #Summoning and rule.summon-order.

specialties.name: Feral
specialties.intent: You are the thing that closes the one hex of daylight, not the thing that keeps it; you run everything down and everything you touch bleeds.

triggers.effect: your claw and brawl attacks apply 1 Bleed

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Beast/Feral (no companion needed — the hero is the beast; claw is a real FORM tag so it carries the attacks) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: armor -1; precision -1; itemSlots -1; health +2. Parked abilities: onKill: move up to 2 hexes immediately.

specialties.name: Beastward
specialties.intent: You are what stands between the party and the things in the treeline, and you pay for every ally you keep upright out of your own body.

triggers.effect: you and every ally within 3 hexes gain +1 Resist for the rest of the Battle

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Beast/Protector (RENAMED — collided with Warden/Protector; rebuilt companion-free as a hero who wards the party against beast, horror and dragon) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: accuracy -5; movement -1. Parked abilities: onAllyDamaged: if the attacker is a beast, horror or dragon and the ally is within 3 hexes of you, reduce that damage by 2.

powers.name: Careful Aim

powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Ranger/Bowmaster, Careful Aim — gated behind standing still, since Reach is the most expensive thing on the sheet) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: carried a condition the engine cannot check ('a Turn in which you have not moved') wrapped around a flat buff. Nothing tracks which attack is next or what form it is. Rewritten as a duration: until the end of your next Turn, your attacks carry it. The form qualifier is dropped with it.
